title: Higher direct images of modules as sheafified cohomology of preimages; stalks
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $p\ge0$, with higher direct image $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-cohomology]. Then $R^pf_*\mathcal F$ is the sheaf associated [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] to the presheaf of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\mathcal P_p:V\mapsto H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F|_{f^{-1}(V)})$ ($\mathcal O_Y(V)$ acting through $f^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y(V)\to\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}V)$), whose restriction maps are the restrictions of [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] (b); that is, there is a morphism of presheaves of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\theta:\mathcal P_p\to R^pf_*\mathcal F$ which is universal among morphisms to sheaves of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules. ($\theta$ is the canonical map: for an injective resolution $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$, it sends the class in $H^p(f^{-1}V,\mathcal F)=H^p(\mathcal I^\bullet(f^{-1}V))$ of a cocycle $s\in\mathcal I^p(f^{-1}V)=(f_*\mathcal I^p)(V)$ to the section over $V$ of $\mathcal H^p(f_*\mathcal I^\bullet)=R^pf_*\mathcal F$ defined by $s$.) Consequently, for $y\in Y$ the induced map $\theta_y:\varinjlim_{V\ni y}H^p(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F)\to(R^pf_*\mathcal F)_y$ from the stalk of the presheaf to the stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-modules. For $p=0$, $R^0f_*\mathcal F=f_*\mathcal F$.

proof.text: Use the existing canonical sectionCohomologyComparison. Its first factor is the inverse of the exact-sheafification homology comparison. Its second factor is homology applied to the sheafification counit on the complex. The counit is invertible degreewise, hence is an isomorphism of complexes and remains invertible on homology. Compose with the inverse of isoRightDerivedObj to prove clause (1).

Let c be that composite isomorphism. Given a presheaf map a to a sheaf Q, its unique factor is c^{-1} followed by the inverse adjunction hom-equivalence applied to a. Naturality of the adjunction identifies its composite with theta with a. Cancellation by c and injectivity of the hom-equivalence prove uniqueness, giving clause (2).

Expand the adjunction hom-equivalence as the unit followed by the forgetful image of c. On module stalks the unit is invertible: after forgetting scalars this is precisely TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso; forgetting to additive groups reflects isomorphisms. The other factor is the stalk image of an isomorphism. This proves clause (3).

For W included in V, openModuleCohomologyRestriction is the right-derived transformation of sectionwise restriction by definition. Compute its component using InjectiveResolution.rightDerived_app_eq and cancel the resolution comparison. Evaluation of the direct-image complex on V is definitionally sections of the original resolution on the inverse image of V. ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans expresses the resulting restriction map as the evaluation-homology comparison at V, restriction on the homology presheaf, and the inverse evaluation-homology comparison at W. Cancel the last inverse with its hom, obtaining clause (4). No separately restricted resolution or h-map choice is needed.

Module direct image agrees definitionally with Scheme.Modules.pushforward, a right adjoint, and so preserves finite limits. Apply Mathlib's degree-zero right-derived isomorphism instance to prove clause (5). Existing ringed-space module Grothendieck/enough-injectives instances supply all right-derived constructions.

The site version lem-weil-pbc-site-higher-direct-image-sheafified-presheaf (072W) is not used: it is stated for abelian sheaves, and R^pf_* here is derived in Mod(O_X) -> Mod(O_Y); using it would need the comparison of module and abelian derived functors, longer than the direct proof.
